options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Character
options.doc: Choose your character!
options.doc_fr: Choisissez votre personnage !

options.name: Difficulty
options.doc:
Determines how strict the randomizer logic will be, and as a result, how difficult your run may be.

Normal: Stricter logic for new players or those looking for a quick, simple run. The randomizer will never expect you to do anything too technical or creative.

Expert: Relaxed logic for those looking for a challenge. The randomizer may expect you to know obscure mechanics, perform precise tricks, or use glitches or other unintended behavior.

options.name: Goal
options.doc:
Determines your goal in this run.
CTOP: Defeat Pizzaface and complete the Crumbling Tower of Pizza.
Snotty: Kill Snotty. Only levels below Snotty's home floor will be accessible.

options.name: Open World
options.doc:
Unlock all floors immediately, making more levels accessible from the start.

If active, boss keys will be removed from the item pool.

options.name: Bonus Ladders
options.doc:
Add bonus ladders to Hub to make accessing levels easier.

Floors up to and including the selected floor number are affected.

Set to 0 to disable bonus ladders.
options.doc_fr:
Ajoutez des échelles bonus au Hub pour faciliter l'accès aux niveaux.

Les planchers jusqu'au numéro d'étage sélectionné sont touchés.

Réglez à 0 pour désactiver les échelles bonus.

options.name: Snotty's Home Floor
options.doc: Determines which floor Snotty will show up on.

options.name: Death Link
options.doc: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_html: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.
options.doc_html_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.

options.name: Ring Link
options.doc:
Links your in-level point gain/loss with other players.
Point gain is only linked when coming from pizza toppings, pizzasonas, clocks and bells.

options.name: Toppin Count
options.doc:
Number of toppins shuffled into the item pool.

May be less than expected if the item pool is too small.

options.name: Floor 1 Boss Toppins
options.doc: Percentage of Toppins required to fight the Floor 1 Boss.

options.name: Floor 2 Boss Toppins
options.doc: Percentage of Toppins required to fight the Floor 2 Boss.

options.name: Floor 3 Boss Toppins
options.doc: Percentage of Toppins required to fight the Floor 3 Boss.

options.name: Floor 4 Boss Toppins
options.doc: Percentage of Toppins required to fight the Floor 4 Boss.

options.name: Floor 5 Boss Toppins
options.doc: Percentage of Toppins required to fight the Floor 5 Boss.

options.name: Shuffle Boss Keys
options.doc:
On: Shuffle Boss Keys into the item pool.

Off: Keep Boss Keys in their normal spots.

options.name: Treasures Award Checks
options.doc: Adds the game's 19 Treasures to the pool as locations.
options.doc_fr: Ajoute les 19 Trésors du jeu à la piscine comme emplacements.

options.name: Secrets Award Checks
options.doc: Adds the game's 57 Secrets to the pool as locations.
options.doc_fr: Ajoute les 57 Secrets du jeu à la piscine comme emplacements.

options.name: S Ranks Award Checks
options.doc:
Adds the game's 24 S Ranks to the pool as locations.

Obtaining a P Rank in a level will also check its corresponding S Rank location.
options.doc_fr:
Ajoute les 24 S Rankings du jeu à la piscine comme emplacements.

L'obtention d'un rang P dans un niveau vérifiera également l'emplacement du rang S correspondant.

options.name: P Ranks Award Checks
options.doc: Adds the game's 24 P Ranks to the pool as locations.
options.doc_fr: Ajoute les 24 P Rankings du jeu à la piscine comme emplacements.

options.name: Chef Tasks Award Checks
options.doc:
Adds the game's 72 Chef Tasks (achievements) to the pool as locations.

If S/P Rank checks are disabled, the no-hit boss Chef Tasks as well as S/P Ranked floor Chef Tasks will set to Excluded.
If Pumpkin checks are enabled, this will also add the 2 pumpkin-related Chef Tasks as checks.
options.doc_fr:
Ajoute les 72 tâches Chef du jeu (réalisations) à la piscine comme emplacements.

Si les vérifications de classement S/P sont désactivées, les tâches de chef sans hit patron ainsi que les tâches de chef d'étage S/P rangés seront réglées à Exclus.
Si les contrôles de citrouille sont activés, cela ajoutera également les 2 tâches de chef liées à la citrouille comme vérifications.

options.name: Pumpkin Checks
options.doc: Adds the game's 30 pumpkins to the pool as locations.
options.doc_fr: Ajoute les 30 citrouilles du jeu à la piscine comme emplacements.

options.name: Pumpkin Count
options.doc:
Number of Pumpkins shuffled into the item pool if pumpkin checks is turned on.

May be less than expected if the item pool is too small.

options.name: Tricky Treat Door Pumpkins
options.doc: Percentage of Pumpkins required to access Tricky Treat.

options.name: Trap Percentage
options.doc: Set a percentage of how many filler items are replaced with traps here.

options.name: Shuffle Clothes
options.doc: Determines whether outfits will be shuffled into the item pool.

options.name: Filler Weights
options.doc: Determines how often each filler item appears in the itempool

options.name: Trap Weights
options.doc: Determines how often each trap appears in the itempool

options.name: Shuffle Level Gates
options.doc: Shuffle level entrances around the Hub.

options.name: Shuffle Boss Gates
options.doc: Shuffle bosses (except Pizzaface) between floors.

options.name: Shuffle Secrets
options.doc: Shuffle Secrets between levels.

options.name: Randomize Moves
options.doc: Determines whether your moves will be randomized. If disabled, only Toppins, Boss Keys, and filler will appear in the item pool.

options.name: Randomize These Moves
options.doc: If "Randomize Moves" is enabled, any move indicated here will be shuffled into the item pool, and any move not indicated here will be useable from the start.

options.name: Randomize Transformations
options.doc:
Determines whether any level-specific Transformations will be shuffled into the item pool.
Enabling this setting in combination with moveset randomization will place 2 movement abilities at the beginning of your world to prevent a restrictive start.

options.name: Randomize These Transformations
options.doc: If "Randomize Transformations" is enabled, any Transformation indicated here will be shuffled into the item pool, and any not indicated here will be useable from the start.

options.name: Shuffle Lap 2 Portals
options.doc:
On: Shuffles an item into the pool that enables all lap 2 portals

Off: Enables all lap 2 portals from the start

options.name: Randomize Music
options.doc: Determines whether in-game music should be randomized.

options.name: Randomize Enemies
options.doc: Determines whether an enemy is replaced with a random other enemy.

options.name: Fairly Random
options.doc:
On: The first two levels will have at least two accessible locations each, and the first boss will not require a grab to defeat.

Off: The first two levels and first boss can be anything.

Only applies when Shuffle Level Gates and/or Shuffle Boss Gates are enabled.
